chapter: Back to Los Angeles and joining Basie
title: Battle with Duke the night before leaving and the cold send-off
summary: They played a battle with Duke Ellington the night before leaving, thought they won, and left Kansas City without anyone saying goodbye.

story.theme_name: Playing with Count Basie: joining, leading, leaving

blocks.x: The Reno Club. Where was it that you said you played this, oh, it was the night before you left, you played the battle of music with Duke?
Well you know, we thought we did. But I don't think we did now. (LAUGHTER). We were just all.....
Well you were probably swinging more.
We were really swinging, but there's more to it than just swing.

And I remember when we left nobody said goodbye. The bus just pulled out and it and we went out with/nobody even thought enough to say are you going to New York? Good luck, nobody said nothing, not a word.
